 Persija Jakarta vs Persik Kediri Live Score Today, October 26, 2026: Latest Score, Lineups, and Match Updates
 Persik Kediri takes an early lead against Persija Jakarta in the seventh week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League at the Jakarta International Stadium.
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Keisya Anjani 
 October 26, 2026, 20:58 WITA · 4 min read 
 Persija Jakarta match against Persik Kediri in the 2026/2027 BRI Super League at the Jakarta International Stadium (JIS), Monday (10/26/2026). (Photo: Illustration/Aktualita.co) 
 JAKARTA, Aktualita.co - Persik Kediri delivered a surprise while facing Persija Jakarta in the seventh week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League at the Jakarta International Stadium (JIS), Monday (10/26/2026) evening. 
 The team nicknamed the White Tigers managed to score first through Imanol Garcia in the 10th minute. The quick goal left Persija Jakarta trailing 0-1 in front of their own supporters. 
 Advertisement 
 Based on the match report published at 19:25 WIB and accessible Sofascore data, Persik leads 1-0 through Imanol Garcia's goal. This score is a temporary update, not the final match result. 
 Persija, who entered the match as the current league leaders, must work hard to overcome the deficit. Conversely, the early lead serves as an important asset for Marcos Reina's squad to apply pressure on the hosts. 
 Persija Jakarta vs Persik Kediri Live Score 
 Here is the match information based on verified reports: 
 Match: Persija Jakarta vs Persik Kediri 
 Current score : Persija 0-1 Persik 
 Goalscorer: Imanol Garcia (10') 
 Competition: BRI Super League 2026/2027 
 Week: Seventh 
 Stadium: Jakarta International Stadium 
 Kick-off: 19:00 WIB 
 Live broadcast: Indosiar and Vidio 
 Persik's opening goal came from a set-piece situation. Ernesto Gomez delivered a corner kick that was successfully capitalized on by Imanol Garcia to break into Persija's goal. 
 The goal was a shocking start for the Kemayoran Tigers, who had previously appeared productive by scoring five goals against Arema FC. 
 Match Progress: Persija vs Persik 
 Persik Kediri showed courage from the start of the match. The visitors did not just aim to maintain their defense but also sought attacking opportunities whenever they found space. 
 In the 10th minute, Persik earned an opportunity through a corner kick. Ernesto Gomez took the set-piece and sent the ball into Persija's defensive area. 
 Imanol Garcia successfully converted that opportunity into the opening goal. The score changed to 0-1 in favor of Persik Kediri. 
 The quick goal forced Persija to adjust their game approach. The Kemayoran Tigers needed a response to avoid dropping points in the top-tier standings race. 
 Persija has several players capable of creating chances, including Witan Sulaiman, Rayhan Hannan, and Alexander Jeremejeff. 
 However, Persik also possesses a defensive line that can complicate the movements of the home players. 
 Based on initial statistics reported by Radar Pati, Persik briefly led possession with 58 percent, while Persija recorded 42 percent. These figures represent the situation in the early phase of the match and may change as the game progresses. 
 Details of events following the 10th-minute goal still require further confirmation from match recording services. 
 Persija Jakarta vs Persik Kediri Lineups 
 Persija coach Shin Tae-yong deployed a 4-2-3-1 formation with Alexander Jeremejeff as the main striker. 
 Meanwhile, Persik Kediri used a 5-3-2 scheme, placing Sergio Castel and Ernesto Gomez in the front line. 
 Persija Jakarta (4-2-3-1): 
 Nadeo Argawinata; Dony Tri Pamungkas, Radovan Pankov, Denis Kolinger, Kerim Memija; Fabio Calonego, Stjepan Loncar; Arlyansyah Abdulmanan, Rayhan Hannan, Witan Sulaiman; Alexander Jeremejeff. 
 Coach: Shin Tae-yong. 
 Persik Kediri (5-3-2): 
 Husna Al Malik; Rendy Sanjaya, Francisco Pereira Carneiro, Marcelo Djalo, Park Jun-heong, Dzaky Asraf; Imanol Garcia, Zanadin Fariz, Eduardo Barbosa; Sergio Castel, Ernesto Gomez. 
 Coach: Marcos Reina. 
 The lineups show the difference in the two teams' approaches. Persija has more players supporting the attack through the flanks, while Persik places five players in the defensive sector. 
 Persija Strives to Maintain Top of the Table 
 Before the match, Persija occupied the first position in the BRI Super League standings with 15 points from six matches. 
 The Kemayoran Tigers recorded five wins and one loss. One of their best results was a 5-1 victory over Arema FC on October 21, 2026. 
 On the other hand, Persik Kediri collected 10 points from six matches. The East Java team arrived with the momentum of a 2-1 win over PSS Sleman. 
 The difference in league position did not cause Persik to lose confidence. This was evident from the visitors' success in taking the lead first. 
 Before the match started, Shin Tae-yong had reminded his players not to underestimate Persik's quality. 
 "The match will not be easy. However, we have prepared tactics to defeat the opponent," said Shin Tae-yong in a pre-match press conference, as reported by ANTARA. 
 The South Korean coach assessed that Persik has good quality players and is capable of applying pressure with disciplined organizational play. 
 Persija Holds Superior Head-to-Head Record 
 Persija has a positive record in recent meetings against Persik Kediri. 
 On May 16, 2026, the Kemayoran Tigers secured a 3-1 victory at Persik's home. Previously, Persija also defeated the same opponent with a 3-1 score in November 2025. 
 That record made Persija the favorites heading into the match. However, Imanol Garcia's quick goal proved that Persik is capable of putting up a fight. 
 This match serves as a test of Persija's ability to turn things around, as well as an opportunity for Persik to end their poor streak in meetings with the capital city team.
